claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox ford Expedition V8 4WD
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a used manual transmission/gearbox assembly with hoses/wiring and no readable make/model/part number, gearbox code, or compatibility markings.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle compatibility is unknown (Ford Expedition V8 4WD vs other applications); part number/gearbox code not readable.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label and any stamped gearbox code/part number (and/or matching VIN/fitment label if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used dismantled manual gearbox assembly with unknown fitment (worst-case: may not bolt up).

risks.risk: Completeness is uncertain: some ports/connectors/parts may be missing or disconnected (internal sensors/solenoids/shift linkage not confirmed).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip showing every connector/port and the full set of included external parts, plus a shot from multiple angles confirming nothing is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing required components).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition is untested: internal gears/synchros could be worn or damaged; no functional test shown.
risks.proof: A short video of the gearbox being rotated/shifted (if possible) showing smooth engagement of gears and no grinding, plus any test/inspection sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/unknown internal condition (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Leak/seal condition unknown: oil level, gasket/seal wear, and whether it’s been leaking are not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the casing for wetness/oil residue, and a shot showing oil level (if any) and underside/seal areas; include a wipe-clean then re-check clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/unknown seals (worst-case: reseal required).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it appears: dusty/sand suggests it may have been exposed; corrosion or damage to ports/lines not confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-ups of all ports/connectors/pipe ends showing whether threads are intact and no cracks/damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and dusty with unknown corrosion/damage (worst-case: damaged ports/lines).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the gearbox identification plate/label and any stamped gearbox code/part number.
Provide photos showing all included external parts (shift linkage, sensors/solenoids if any, connectors) and confirm what is missing.
Share a short video showing the gearbox being rotated/shifted smoothly (or any test results/inspection report).
Show close-ups of seals/gaskets and any oil residue/wetness around the casing and ports.
Confirm whether the pictured assembly is complete for Ford Expedition V8 4WD (include fitment/compatibility documentation if available).
response.reason: The witness can confirm it’s a used dismantled manual transmission/gearbox assembly, but the seller’s specific Ford Expedition V8 4WD compatibility and completeness cannot be verified from the reported images. Proof is needed (ID plate/part number and completeness/test evidence) before a reliable price.
